description: moonshine-ai/moonshine language-bindings/wasm (MIT, v0.1.5, 2026-08-24) runs Moonshine v2 Streaming (Tiny 34M, Small 123M, Medium 245M; en plus ja/es/de/zh/ar/vi/tl) with cached encoder/decoder state, built-in Silero VAD in C++, ORT minimal build with .ort models. Published npm build is SIMD+pthreads and needs SharedArrayBuffer; the simulator has none and the packaged Even app is likely not isolated. Build the SIMD-only variant (scripts/build-ort-wasm.sh single-thread, scripts/build-wasm.sh single-thread, emsdk 4.0.8). Benchmark two_cities.wav and our fixtures fed as live 100 ms frames with Tiny/Small/Medium: per-update compute, speech-end -> final latency, load time, memory; in the Even simulator, Android Even app, iOS Even app (plus desktop Chrome for reference). Pass criterion: Small (en) holds real time with headroom on both phones alongside CAM++. Also check: CSP/wasm-unsafe-eval, worker bundling under Vite, loading verified bytes via Transcriber.load({files}), coexistence with onnxruntime-web memory. Record numbers on this ticket.

comments.text: Spike done (jj rev 'Vendor single-thread Moonshine Streaming WASM; spike bench'). Built single-thread SIMD moonshine-wasm from moonshine-ai/moonshine@234f60fa (emsdk 4.0.8, ORT 1.23.2 minimal; ~7.5 min build; upstream script needed flatbuffers python module and builds the threaded archive first, patched with SKIP_THREADED). Vendored as vendor/moonshine-wasm (@irl/moonshine-wasm, STT subset, 13 MB wasm) + scripts/build-moonshine-wasm.sh. Loads in a module worker under Vite, CSP unchanged (wasm-unsafe-eval already allowed), Transcriber.load({files}) takes verified bytes. Results single thread, two_cities 44 s: Even simulator (WebKitGTK/JSC) Tiny load 296 ms, compute 0.218x RT, pass p50/p95 119/197 ms, line latency 55-191 ms; Small load 420 ms, 0.639x, 332/651 ms, 192-664 ms; Medium load 465 ms, 0.882x, 649/1467 ms, 386-1449 ms. Node V8: Tiny 0.188x, Small 0.637x, Medium 0.874x. Compare current Moonshine Base path in the simulator after kdl.2: load 4.0 s, 950 ms per STT call, final lag p95 3.2 s. Model files: official .ort only on download.moonshine.ai (CORS *, versioned paths e.g. quantized_26_08_21); HF moonshine-ai repos only have safetensors. Sizes en: Tiny 45 MB, Small 142 MB, Medium 279 MB. Decision: proceed with kdl.8/kdl.9 (pin CDN files by sha256), default en Small with Tiny for battery/slow devices; kdl.10 fallback not needed unless device runs fail. Phone runs (Android/iOS Even app) could not be done from this machine (no devices attached): filed as a follow-up ticket.

Fix (2026-09-14, after landing): .gitignore's dist/ rule kept vendor/moonshine-wasm/dist (the WASM runtime and its JS) out of the commit, and jj also skips new files over snapshot.max-new-file-size (1 MiB). It only existed in the kdl workspace, so a fresh checkout failed to resolve @irl/moonshine-wasm in the stream worker (WebKit: internallyFailedLoadTimerFired; warmup: 'stream worker crashed'). Restored the same build from the pinned commit, added !vendor/moonshine-wasm/dist/ to .gitignore, tracked it with a raised size limit, squashed into rev ppotzmuy. Verified from the main checkout: simulator loads Small with no WebKit errors (jfk final lag p95 0.77 s), pnpm check 77/77, streaming live test passes.

title: Spike: single-thread @moonshine-ai/moonshine-wasm build and phone benchmarks
